fn parse_document_release(input: &str) -> Document {
    let mut parser = Parser::new(input);
    parser.parse_release_mode()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod benches {
    use super::*;
    use test::Bencher;

    #[bench]
    fn bench_parse_small_release(b: &mut Bencher) {
        let input = "sample document content";
        b.iter(|| parse_document_release(input));
    }
}
